notes: Kühl Q-chassis window/wall unit, cool only. All part numbers here are from the SQ08N10-A column.

gaps: The specifications table gives 6.1 cooling amps and 700 W, while the performance data table gives 6.6 amps cool for SQ08N10-A.
The unit's 115 V rating and 125 V 15 A circuit rating are unit-level figures, kept off the compressor.
method: Source: Friedrich 'Service/Parts Manual 2012, Room Air Conditioners, Q Chassis Models' (doc 93001401_01, Kuhl Q Serv/Parts Man 4-12), covering SQ05N10, SQ06N10, SQ08N10, SQ10N10 and EQ08N11; read from the Internet Archive copy (manualsonline mirror) with the text layer, and the parts list (PDF p.
63, printed p. 62) and performance data (PDF p. 7, printed p. 6) were also rendered as images to confirm which column each part belongs to.
The parts list gives a quantity per model, used as qty.
The model-number code (PDF p. 6, printed p. 5) says the 5th character N means the series was introduced in 2012.
Thermistor resistance table (PDF p. 56) applies to all thermistors.
The overload protector and fuse markings are as printed.

comps.spec: Compressor replacement kit, Friedrich part 61718107 ('KIT COMPR REPLMT 62200118', parts list item 3, qty 1 for SQ08N10-A); SQ08N10-A performance data: locked rotor amps 32.0, R-410A charge 22.0 oz; listed with 3 compressor studs 91400402 and 3 compressor grommets 61028903
Dual capacitor printed in the parts list as 'CAPACITOR 45/7.5 MF 370V 2.0', Friedrich part 61080532 (non-illustrated item, qty 1), held by capacitor strap 60062720

Fan motor, Friedrich part 61871501 (item 7, qty 1); Components Testing describes a single-phase permanent split capacitor motor driving the evaporator blower and condenser fan, with a self-resetting internal overload
Blower wheel 60610604 (item 15, qty 1) and condenser fan 61634000 (item 19, qty 1)

Thermistor set, kit 62601027 ('KIT SENSOR RPLMNT SVC KUHL Q (THERMISTOR SET)', qty 1); relay board test page marks indoor and outdoor coil thermistors; user interface test checks a room temperature thermistor; table: 10.0 k ohm at 77 F, 26.054 k ohm at 32 F
Compressor overload protector printed as 'OVERLOAD PROTECTOR B260-150-241E/MRA12335-12026', Friedrich part 61764601 (item 6, qty 1)

Electronic control (relay board) kit 62601023 ('KIT E-CNTL SERV COOL 3SP KUHL Q', item 5, qty 1); the test page shows fan high, medium and low speed outputs, a 5 VDC and a 3.3 VDC test point, and a heat relay position used only on heat/cool units
Relay board fuse marked T 3.15AH 250 Volts AC (Components Testing, Testing the Relay Board)
User interface board kit 62601028 ('KIT USER INTERFACE RPLMNT SVC KUHL SQ', item 4, qty 1); test page gives 5 VDC supply and a 3.3 VDC check point
Sealed-system parts for SQ08N10-A: condenser coil 61600523, evaporator coil 61600275, capillary tube 03760513, strainer .312 coil 61834800, liquid drier 61828202; R-410A system
Supply cord 60500500 (item 9, qty 1); circuit rating table gives 125 V 15 A and a NEMA 5-15P plug

sources.title: Friedrich Kühl Q-chassis Service/Parts Manual 2012 (SQ05N10, SQ06N10, SQ08N10, SQ10N10, EQ08N11), doc 93001401_01, rev. 4-12 (Internet Archive copy)
